title: hp-Finite Elements for Elastoplasticity
summary: This article considers a model problem of elastoplasticity with linearly kinematic hardening and presents hp-finite element discretizations of two equivalent weak formulations each having their respective advantages. A mixed variational formulation is introduced to resolve the non-differentiablility of the so-called plasticity functional appearing in the weak formulation of the model problem as a variational inequality of the second kind.
